name: National Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities (NIMHANS / NSP)
description: Central government scholarship under the National Scholarship Portal for students with benchmark disabilities (40% or more) pursuing post-matric education.
documents: Disability Certificate (40% or above, issued by CMO/Civil Surgeon)
Income Certificate (family income below ₹2.5 lakh per annum)
Previous Year Marks Card / Admit Card
benefits: Scholarship amount varies by course level
Additional allowances for reader, escort, and transport for severely disabled students
deadline_note: NSP applications typically open August–October. Renewal by November. Check scholarships.gov.in for exact dates.
notes: Applicant must not be availing any other scholarship from central/state government simultaneously. UDID card is preferred but not mandatory if CMO certificate is valid.
